# isEqual

> Test whether two 64-bit unsigned integers are equal.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var isEqual = require( '@stdlib/number/uint64/base/assert/is-equal' );
```

#### isEqual( a, b )

Tests whether two 64-bit unsigned integers are equal.

```javascript
var Uint64 = require( '@stdlib/number/uint64/ctor' );

var a = new Uint64( 1234 );
var b = Uint64.of( 0, 1234 );

var out = isEqual( a, b );
// returns true
```

#### isEqual.words( ah, al, bh, bl )

Tests whether two 64-bit unsigned integers are equal using word comparison.

```javascript
var bool = isEqual.words( 0, 5, 0, 5 );
// returns true

bool = isEqual.words( 0, 5, 0, 10 );
// returns false
```

The function supports the following parameters:

-   **ah**: high 32-bit word of the first 64-bit unsigned integer.
-   **al**: low 32-bit word of the first 64-bit unsigned integer.
-   **bh**: high 32-bit word of the second 64-bit unsigned integer.
-   **bl**: low 32-bit word of the second 64-bit unsigned integer.

#### isEqual.strided( a, strideA, offsetA, b, strideB, offsetB )

Tests whether two 64-bit unsigned integers stored in integer-valued strided array views are equal.

```javascript
var Uint32Array = require( '@stdlib/array/uint32' );

var a = new Uint32Array( [ 0, 5 ] );
var b = new Uint32Array( [ 0, 5 ] );

var bool = isEqual.strided( a, 1, 0, b, 1, 0 );
// returns true

b = new Uint32Array( [ 0, 10 ] );

bool = isEqual.strided( a, 1, 0, b, 1, 0 );
// returns false
```

The function supports the following parameters:

-   **a**: first 64-bit unsigned integer strided array view containing interleaved 32-bit unsigned integer high and low order words.
-   **strideA**: stride length for `a`.
-   **offsetA**: starting index for `a`.
-   **b**: second 64-bit unsigned integer strided array view containing interleaved 32-bit unsigned integer high and low order words.
-   **strideB**: stride length for `b`.
-   **offsetB**: starting index for `b`.

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- Package usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var Uint64 = require( '@stdlib/number/uint64/ctor' );
var Uint32Array = require( '@stdlib/array/uint32' );
var isEqual = require( '@stdlib/number/uint64/base/assert/is-equal' );

var a = new Uint64( 1234 );
var b = Uint64.of( 0, 1234 );
var out = isEqual( a, b );
// returns true

a = new Uint64( 1234 );
b = new Uint64( 5678 );
out = isEqual( a, b );
// returns false

out = isEqual.words( 0, 1234, 0, 1234 );
// returns true

out = isEqual.words( 0, 1234, 0, 5678 );
// returns false

var x = new Uint32Array( [ 0, 1234 ] );
var y = new Uint32Array( [ 0, 1234 ] );
out = isEqual.strided( x, 1, 0, y, 1, 0 );
// returns true

y = new Uint32Array( [ 0, 5678 ] );
out = isEqual.strided( x, 1, 0, y, 1, 0 );
// returns false
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
